blocks.text: Atsuko Okatsuka will return to Manila with The Big Bowl Tour on November 15, 2026, at the New Frontier Theater, brought to you by Insignia Presents and Bohm Presents. Atsuko last performed in the city in 2024, when she sold out three consecutive shows. This November, she brings a full show of brand-new material for Filipino fans. Atsuko’s 2024–2025 FULL GROWN world tour sold out more than 200 shows across over 100 cities in 20+ countries, with Manila among its standout stops. She has since released her second stand-up special, FATHER, which premiered on Hulu and internationally on Disney+ and landed […]...
